manifest.name: Custom LLM
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Bring your own LLM endpoint - any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible server (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, OpenRouter, ...).

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your endpoint's API key, if it requires one. Leave empty for local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM) that don't.

api.label: API
api.description: The request dialect your endpoint speaks

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Server root URL. OpenAI-compatible: include the version path, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Anthropic: just the host, e.g. https://api.anthropic.com

model.label: Model
model.description: Model id served by your endpoint

maxTokens.label: Max Tokens (optional)
maxTokens.description: Response token limit. Anthropic requires it - defaults to 1024. Thinking models need headroom for reasoning plus the answer.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning
reasoningEffort.description: Thinking effort for reasoning models (GLM, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, ...). Auto (default) sends nothing and leaves it to the model; Off best-effort disables thinking, which helps when a thinking model spends its whole token budget reasoning. On the Anthropic dialect, chat turns that can call tools never use thinking.
